name: tablelab
description: Solver-grounded, anti-AI-slop voice for TableLab — a live cash + tournament poker bankroll tracker. Insider peer register for numerate live players. Programmatic mirror of project-root VOICE.md + BRAND.md.
industry: Poker / sports-and-gaming software (bankroll tracking + solver-grounded analysis)
audience: Serious recreational-to-semi-pro LIVE poker players (cash + MTT) who track results — numerate, advanced, skeptical of marketing and of 'AI coaching' claims; value accuracy and data ownership
mission: Help live cash and tournament players track their results honestly and understand their game with solver-grounded analysis — no hype, no black box
do: Separate solver output (deterministic GTO facts) from AI prose/heuristics explicitly whenever both appear in a piece
Show the math with its assumptions — state equity/EV/frequency alongside SPR, ranges, and position, never floating free
Speak as the brand 'we' and address the reader directly as 'you'
Use real, checkable examples — actual hands, ranges, and sample sizes over generalities
Use poker lingo (hero/villain/nit/SPR/ICM/MDF) naturally for an advanced audience; define a term only when a piece reaches a broader reader
Be honest about limits — say plainly when a spot is multiway or otherwise unsolvable and the analysis is heuristic
dont: Don't imply the AI/LLM 'solves' poker or computes GTO frequencies itself — a CFR solver (TexasSolver) does that; the AI only explains and reasons heuristically
Don't use AI-hype phrasing: 'AI-powered coaching', 'AI poker coach', 'GTO AI', 'our AI solver', 'powered by AI', 'leverage AI', 'revolutionary', 'game-changing', 'next-generation', 'cutting-edge'
Don't promise outcomes — no 'AI will fix your game', 'guaranteed edge', 'crush the games', 'unlock your potential'
Don't write sentences longer than 30 words, or paragraphs longer than 150 words
Don't use first-person singular (I/me); the brand voice is 'we'
Don't open with slop connectives — 'Let's dive in', "In today's...", "It's no secret that", 'game-changer'
Don't publish unsourced statistics or any invented solver number
